"""Pure source adapter; reads prior helper sources and pure proofs only."""
from pathlib import Path
import json
from hashlib import sha256

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
OLD = ROOT / '.tmp/ex056-param-prototype'
NEW = ROOT / '.tmp/ex057-param-prototype'
CHECKS = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
NEW.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
files = ('run_parameters.py', 'parameter_analysis.py', 'pair_parameters.py', 'declare_geometry.py')
changes = {
    'EX056': 'EX057', 'ex056': 'ex057',
    'RAW_BEAR_TIME_BELOW_BODY_CLOSE_ACF_RECOVERY': 'RAW_BEAR_TIME_BELOW_BODY_SUPPORTED_ACF_RECOVERY',
    'dual_recovery_oracle': 'supported_recovery_oracle',
    'audit_dual_recovery': 'audit_supported_recovery',
    '8240': '8540', '8271': '8571', '8272': '8572', '8280': '8580',
    'BODY-and-CLOSE-positive': 'BODY-positive and originalscore>=0 supported',
    'BODY-and-CLOSE': 'BODY-and-nonnegative-score',
    'BODY/CLOSE': 'BODY/support',
    'currentClose>currentSignalOpen AND currentClose>strictPreviousClose': 'currentClose>currentSignalOpen AND originalconfirmationScore>=0',
    'recovery contains no score': 'recovery contains fixed score>=0 support but no tunable confirmation cutoff; original confirmation still applies',
    'joint-versus-CLOSE-only price predicate': 'BODY-plus-fixed-score-support versus CLOSE-only predicate',
    'Dual predicate uses current signalClose/Open and complete previousClose without extra warmup': 'Supported BODY recovery uses current signalClose/Open and original composite score>=0 without extra warmup',
    'flatrawbear priorfinalbearTIME strictBELOW BODY-and-nonnegative-score-positive recovery': 'flatrawbear priorfinalbearTIME strictBELOW BODY-positive with originalscore>=0 recovery',
    'locally adding ACF-failing dual-positive entries': 'locally adding ACF-failing supported BODY-positive entries',
}
for name in files:
    text = (OLD / name).read_text('utf-8')
    for before, after in changes.items():
        text = text.replace(before, after)
    if name == 'declare_geometry.py':
        start = text.index('        selection_history=')
        end = text.index('\n        counts=', start)
        text = text[:start] + '''        selection_history="Prior RAW BELOW CLOSE/BODY gates restricted alreadyeligible entries and failed frequency. Root-supplied EX055 BODY-only recovery passed return/DD/frequency but failed2023 (-0.0252056%). Fixed57 zero-score support is the mathematical neutral point of original EQUAL_BLOCKS rank score, not a fitted cutoff or extra numeric coordinate. It changes only local ACF-failing BODY recovery; originalACFpass opportunities retain originaltheta, even negative score. A supported exception must still pass originaltheta (which may exceed0). Stricter support can miss good entries or reduce frequency; no promise of fixing loss, no per-year rule. Only historical55 opportunities referenced, no57 actual opportunity projection. Adaptive exposed development pool, no independent validation or category/window optimization.",''' + text[end:]
        text = text.replace('excludes score;', 'includes fixed originalscore>=0 support, not originaltheta;')
        text = text.replace('            "All13 original numerical domains/', '            "Fixed0 support is structural, outside13 numeric domains; original confirmation.threshold remains active and distinct. OriginalACFpass negative scores are not vetoed; score0 equality supports only exception; theta>0 may still reject support. No claim of support-constant stability or independent validation",\n            "All13 original numerical domains/')
    (NEW / name).write_text(text, encoding='utf-8')

text = (ROOT / '.tmp/ex056-param-checks/focused_checks.py').read_text('utf-8')
for before, after in changes.items():
    text = text.replace(before, after)
# Exact unchanged functions are compared with immediately preceding frozen helpers.
text = text.replace('previous = ROOT / ".tmp/ex055-param-prototype"', 'previous = ROOT / ".tmp/ex056-param-prototype"')
start = text.index('    prior_runtime_proof =')
end = text.index('    for diagnostic_qualified in', start)
text = text[:start] + '''    prior_runtime_proof = ROOT / ".tmp/ex057-supported-recovery-prototype/focused.json"
    proof = json.loads(prior_runtime_proof.read_text("utf-8"))
    check("frozen85 supported proof bound only, no runtime source read",
          proof["status"] == "PURE_PASS" and proof["check_count"] == 85
          and proof["native_account_reads"] == proof["market_reads"] == 0
          and proof["new_account_evaluations"] == 0)
    check("fixed score supports only exception; originaltheta still applies",
          all(term in proof["checks"] for term in (
              "local_support_zero_boundary_0.0",
              "originalpassing_negative_or_positive_bodydown_entry_preserved_-0.1",
              "higher_theta_supported_recovery_still_confirmation_rejected",
              "holding_TIME_preserved_despite_support_gate")))
''' + text[end:]
start = text.index('    check(\n        "dual runtime gap/equality proof explicitly referenced",')
end = text.index('    check(\n        "new helper never describes', start)
text = text[:start] + '''    check("structural neutral0 support separate from originalnumericthreshold",
          "outside13 numeric domains" in disclosure
          and "original confirmation.threshold remains active" in disclosure
          and "No claim of support-constant stability" in disclosure)
''' + text[end:]
text = text.replace('dual predicate described without veto', 'supported predicate described without veto')
text = text.replace('prior55 2023 failure disclosed not future56 prediction', 'prior55 failure disclosed not future57 prediction')
text = text.replace('all33 valid ID fixtures iterated', 'all33 prospective ID fixtures iterated')
(CHECKS / 'focused_checks.py').write_text(text, encoding='utf-8')
(CHECKS / 'source_adapter.json').write_text(json.dumps({
    'status': 'PURE_SOURCE_ADAPTER', 'old_sources': {name: sha256((OLD/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for name in files},
    'native_account_reads': 0, 'market_reads': 0, 'new_account_evaluations': 0,
    'new_sources': {name: sha256((NEW/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for name in files}
}, indent=2), encoding='utf-8')

"""Pure helper tests; all financial/native read, prepare/evaluate/publish are spies."""

from copy import deepcopy
from hashlib import sha256
import importlib.util
import inspect
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import types
from unittest.mock import patch

import optuna
from strategy_evaluator import (
    AssessmentCandidate,
    ParameterCoordinate,
    ParameterCoordinateKind,
    ParameterDesignRequest,
    ParameterPerturbationProtocol,
    ParameterSpace,
    build_parameter_perturbation_design,
)
from strategy_manager import CandidateKey
from czsc_trader.research_tools import EvaluationLineage, ParameterEvaluationPlan


HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT = next(parent for parent in HERE.parents if (parent / "research/S013/experiments").is_dir())
SOURCE = ROOT / ".tmp/ex057-param-prototype"


def main():
    checks, financial_calls, writes = [], [], {}

    def check(name, condition):
        assert condition, name
        checks.append(name)

    def refuse(name, callback):
        try:
            callback()
        except (AssertionError, ValueError, TypeError):
            checks.append(name)
        else:
            raise AssertionError("Expected explicit refusal: " + name)

    def forbidden(*args, **kwargs):
        financial_calls.append((args, kwargs))
        raise AssertionError("Financial account operation or read forbidden")

    common = types.ModuleType("common")
    for name, value in {
        "ROOT": ROOT,
        "SRC": SOURCE,
        "CACHE": HERE / "no-native-cache",
        "PROTOCOLS": HERE / "no-formal-protocols",
        "RUNS": HERE / "no-financial-runs",
        "EXPERIMENT": types.SimpleNamespace(experiment_id="EX057_PROTOTYPE"),
        "SOURCE_CALLS": [],
        "cache_read": forbidden,
        "cache_write": forbidden,
        "read": forbidden,
        "write": lambda path, value: writes.update({str(path): deepcopy(value)}),
        "file_hash": lambda _path: "a" * 64,
        "context": lambda _workers=1: types.SimpleNamespace(
            evaluation=types.SimpleNamespace(
                prepare=forbidden, evaluate=forbidden, evaluate_many=forbidden
            )
        ),
    }.items():
        setattr(common, name, value)
    sys.modules["common"] = common
    for name, attributes in {
        "account_reference": {"verify_account": forbidden},
        "analysis_reference": {"annual": forbidden},
        "supported_recovery_oracle": {"audit_supported_recovery": forbidden},
    }.items():
        module = types.ModuleType(name)
        module.__dict__.update(attributes)
        sys.modules[name] = module

    def load(name):
        spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, SOURCE / (name + ".py"))
        module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
        sys.modules[name] = module
        spec.loader.exec_module(module)
        return module

    runner, analysis, pairs, declaration = (
        load(name)
        for name in ("run_parameters", "parameter_analysis", "pair_parameters", "declare_geometry")
    )
    parent_plan = json.loads(
        (ROOT / "research/S013/experiments/EX012_20261011/protocols/plan.json").read_text(
            encoding="utf-8"
        )
    )
    center = next(
        row["payload"]["parameters"]
        for row in parent_plan["configurations"]
        if row["candidate_id"] == "C2132"
    )
    original_geometry = json.loads(
        (ROOT / "research/S013/experiments/EX046_20261011/protocols/geometry.json").read_text(
            encoding="utf-8"
        )
    )
    geometry = declaration.build_geometry(original_geometry)
    for key in ("protocol", "coordinates", "origins", "mapping", "feasibility"):
        check(
            "original complete geometry unchanged " + key, geometry[key] == original_geometry[key]
        )
    check(
        "new RAW BELOW oracle vs frozen legacy oracle distinct",
        "supported_recovery_oracle_sha256" in geometry
        and geometry["legacy_direction_oracle"]["path"].endswith(
            "EX043_20261011/src/direction_oracle.py"
        ),
    )
    check(
        "prospective reservation consistent",
        geometry["candidate_reservation"]
        == {"first": runner.RESERVED_FIRST, "last": runner.RESERVED_LAST}
        == {"first": 8540, "last": 8571},
    )
    check(
        "registered implementation parent is original",
        "row['label'] == 'B0-TIME'"
        in inspect.getsource(runner.implementation_parent).replace('"', "'"),
    )
    identifiers = [8580, *range(8540, 8572)]
    assert len(identifiers) == 33 and len(set(identifiers)) == 33
    for identifier in identifiers:
        CandidateKey("S013", f"C{identifier:04d}")
    check("all33 IDs strong CandidateKey contract only, not collision approval", True)
    check(
        "public plan methods exist",
        callable(ParameterEvaluationPlan.create)
        and callable(ParameterEvaluationPlan.bind_point)
        and "dataflows" in inspect.signature(ParameterEvaluationPlan.create).parameters,
    )
    check(
        "public lineage supports derivation and parameter binding",
        {"derivation", "parameter_binding"} <= set(inspect.signature(EvaluationLineage).parameters),
    )
    protocol = ParameterPerturbationProtocol(**geometry["protocol"])
    designs = []
    for label, candidate in (("B0-TIME", "C2132"), ("B0-COUPLED", "C4900"), ("N0", "C8580")):
        space = ParameterSpace(
            tuple(
                ParameterCoordinate(
                    name,
                    float(runner.get_path(center, name)),
                    low,
                    high,
                    ParameterCoordinateKind(kind),
                )
                for name, low, high, kind in geometry["coordinates"]
            ),
            "a" * 64,
            "b" * 64,
        )
        result = build_parameter_perturbation_design(
            ParameterDesignRequest(
                AssessmentCandidate("S013-" + candidate, "c" * 64), protocol, space
            ),
            feasibility=runner.feasible,
        )
        assert result.status.value == "COMPLETE"
        designs.append(result.design)
    check(
        "public full13 three-center same32 coordinates",
        all(
            design.space.coordinates == designs[0].space.coordinates
            and design.points == designs[0].points
            for design in designs
        ),
    )
    p = {**deepcopy(center), "mechanism": "RAW_BEAR_TIME_BELOW_BODY_SUPPORTED_ACF_RECOVERY"}
    for point in designs[2].points:
        materialized = runner.materialize(p, geometry, point.coordinates)
        assert materialized["mechanism"] == p["mechanism"]
        assert runner.feasible(point.coordinates)
        for name, _low, _high, kind in geometry["coordinates"]:
            value = runner.get_path(materialized, name)
            assert type(value) is (int if kind == "INTEGER" else float)
        assert p == {**center, "mechanism": "RAW_BEAR_TIME_BELOW_BODY_SUPPORTED_ACF_RECOVERY"}
    check("all32 materialization preserves types and original base", True)
    check(
        "native alias cache isolation",
        runner.point_cache("B0-COUPLED", "N0-P00") != runner.point_cache("N0", "N0-P00"),
    )
    refuse("invalid cache label", lambda: runner.point_cache("N0", "N0-P00/../bad"))
    refuse("invalid control alias", lambda: runner.point_cache("OLD", "N0-P00"))
    manifest = {"reused_rows": [{"label": str(index)} for index in range(64)]}
    state = {"rows": deepcopy(manifest["reused_rows"])}
    reused_count = len(manifest["reused_rows"])
    trial_numbers = []
    optuna.logging.set_verbosity(optuna.logging.WARNING)
    study = optuna.create_study(
        direction="maximize", sampler=optuna.samplers.RandomSampler(seed=13)
    )
    for index in range(32):
        study.enqueue_trial({"point": index})
    for index in range(32):
        trial = study.ask()
        assert trial.suggest_int("point", 0, 31) == index
    for offset in range(0, 32, 8):
        for index in range(offset, offset + 8):
            trial_index = runner.trial_index(reused_count + index, reused_count)
            study.tell(trial_index, float(index))
            trial_numbers.append(trial_index)
            state["rows"].append({"label": "N0-P" + str(index)})
    check(
        "32 unique fixed Optuna trials 4batches8 no alias mutation",
        trial_numbers == list(range(32))
        and len(state["rows"]) == 96
        and len(manifest["reused_rows"]) == 64
        and all(trial.state.name == "COMPLETE" for trial in study.trials),
    )
    for global_index in (63, 96):
        refuse(
            "trial outside fixed32 " + str(global_index),
            lambda value=global_index: runner.trial_index(value, 64),
        )
    refuse("mutating reused count not accepted", lambda: runner.trial_index(65, 65))
    experiment = {
        "controls": [{"label": "B0-TIME"}, {"label": "B0-COUPLED"}],
        "configurations": [
            {
                "label": "N0",
                "mechanism": "RAW_BEAR_TIME_BELOW_BODY_SUPPORTED_ACF_RECOVERY",
                "parent_control": "B0-TIME",
            }
        ],
    }
    for qualified in (False, True):
        result = runner.select_new_centers(experiment, {"rows": {"N0": {"qualified": qualified}}})
        check(
            "center selection only original four-gate flag " + str(qualified),
            bool(result) is qualified,
        )
    wrong = deepcopy(experiment)
    wrong["configurations"][0]["parent_control"] = "B0-COUPLED"
    refuse(
        "historical coupled is not implementation parent",
        lambda: runner.select_new_centers(wrong, {"rows": {"N0": {"qualified": True}}}),
    )

    # Invoke actual no-qualification branches, with all account/API capabilities
    # replaced by refusal spies. Source validation is supplied as frozen metadata.
    no_qualification = {
        "status": "PASS",
        "rows": {key: {"qualified": key != "N0"} for key in ("B0-TIME", "B0-COUPLED", "N0")},
    }
    for label in ("B0-RAW-RECOVERY",):
        no_qualification["rows"][label] = {"qualified": False}
    material_calls = []

    def fake_publish(_ctx, name, value):
        material_calls.append((name, deepcopy(value)))
        return types.SimpleNamespace(to_dict=lambda: {"pure_spy": True})

    with (
        patch.object(runner, "source_check", lambda: (experiment, geometry)),
        patch.object(runner, "read", lambda _path: no_qualification),
        patch.object(runner, "publish_material", fake_publish),
    ):
        runner.declare()
    not_applicable = writes[str(runner.MANIFEST)]
    check(
        "unqualified declaration zero preparations/evaluations/reuse",
        not_applicable["status"] == "NOT_APPLICABLE"
        and all(
            not_applicable[key] == 0
            for key in (
                "new_parameter_business_accounts",
                "reused_parameter_accounts",
                "actual_parameter_evaluations",
                "planned_actual_parameter_evaluations",
                "technical_duplicate_evaluations",
            )
        ),
    )
    with (
        patch.object(runner, "source_check", lambda: (experiment, geometry)),
        patch.object(runner, "read", lambda _path: not_applicable),
    ):
        runner.precheck()
        runner.run()
    with (
        patch.object(analysis, "source_check", lambda: (experiment, geometry)),
        patch.object(analysis, "read", lambda _path: not_applicable),
    ):
        analysis.main()
    check(
        "diagnostic MEAN flag retained only as metadata zero parameter eval",
        not_applicable["qualified_flags"]["B0-RAW-RECOVERY"] is False
        and not_applicable["reused_parameter_accounts"] == 0,
    )
    check(
        "unqualified analysis/pair without native cache reads",
        writes[str(common.RUNS / "parameter_analysis.json")]["status"]
        == pairs.pair_analysis(not_applicable)["status"]
        == "NOT_APPLICABLE",
    )
    oracle_calls = []

    def new_oracle(*_args):
        oracle_calls.append("new")
        return {"native": "new"}

    def old_oracle(*_args):
        oracle_calls.append("legacy")
        return {"native": "legacy"}

    with (
        patch.object(analysis, "audit_supported_recovery", new_oracle),
        patch.object(analysis, "load_legacy_oracle", lambda: old_oracle),
    ):
        assert analysis.audit_signal_path(
            "N0", None, None, None, {"mechanism": "RAW_BEAR_TIME_BELOW_BODY_SUPPORTED_ACF_RECOVERY"}
        ) == {"native": "new"}
        assert analysis.audit_signal_path(
            "B0-COUPLED", None, None, None, {"mechanism": "MEAN_BEAR_TIME_BELOW_CLOSE"}
        ) == {"native": "legacy"}
        assert analysis.audit_signal_path("B0-TIME", None, None, None, {}) is None
        refuse(
            "never audit oldcoupled using new oracle",
            lambda: analysis.audit_signal_path(
                "N0", None, None, None, {"mechanism": "MEAN_BEAR_TIME_BELOW_CLOSE"}
            ),
        )
    check("new oracle N0 only, frozen legacy coupled only", oracle_calls == ["new", "legacy"])
    received_thresholds = []
    def threshold_spy(_ctx, _bound, _frame, parameters):
        received_thresholds.append(parameters["confirmation"]["threshold"])
        return {"threshold_received": parameters["confirmation"]["threshold"]}
    with patch.object(analysis, "audit_supported_recovery", threshold_spy):
        for threshold in (-.5, 0., .5):
            parameters = {"mechanism": runner.MECHANISM,
                          "confirmation": {"threshold": threshold}}
            audit = analysis.audit_signal_path("N0", None, None, None, parameters)
            assert audit["threshold_received"] == threshold
    check("parameter oracle receives every dynamic originalthreshold unchanged, not support0",
          received_thresholds == [-.5, 0., .5])
    fake_panel = {"status": "PASS", "points": {}, "summaries": {}}
    for label in ("B0-TIME", "B0-COUPLED", "N0"):
        fake_panel["points"][label] = [
            {
                "point_index": point.index,
                "coordinates": list(point.coordinates),
                "actual_radius": point.actual_radius,
                "net_cagr": 0.10,
                "drawdown": 0.20,
                "annual": {"2022": {"return": 0.01}, "2023": {"return": 0.02}},
                "closed_trades": 112,
                "qualified": True,
            }
            for point in designs[0].points
        ]
        fake_panel["summaries"][label] = {
            "center_qualified": True,
            "role": "SYNTHETIC_FIXTURE_ONLY",
            "q10_cagr": 0.10,
            "q90_drawdown": 0.20,
            "return_degradation": 0.01,
            "drawdown_degradation": 0.02,
        }
    paired = pairs.pair_analysis(fake_panel)
    check(
        "three pair comparisons each complete32 strict coordinates",
        paired["status"] == "PASS"
        and set(paired["comparisons"]) == {"N0", "N0-vs-B0-COUPLED", "B0-COUPLED"}
        and all(
            row["complete_pairs"] == 32 and row["cagr_same_points"] == 32
            for row in paired["comparisons"].values()
        ),
    )
    zero_qualified = deepcopy(fake_panel)
